render_game_map: render a pydipcc Game object into a visual map string using the external diplomacy renderer
render_game_at_phase: render a pydipcc Game rolled back to a specific phase end and return the map string
render_game_hide_orders: render a pydipcc Game map with all orders hidden by passing hide_orders=True
render_game_no_abbrev: render a pydipcc Game map with abbreviations disabled by passing incl_abbrev=False
review_render_function: review the render function that converts a pydipcc Game to a rendered map string via diplomacy.engine.renderer
